airport: An airport features expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings, large terminal buildings, and extensive aprons with parked aircraft, distinguishing it from the dense building clusters of residential areas, the flat-roofed commercial complexes, and the large factory structures of industrial zones.
beach: A beach appears as a broad, smooth expanse of fine light tan sand with a gentle natural transition to water and subtle wave patterns, distinguishing it from the vast uniform dry sand of desert, the enclosed still water of pond, and the sinuous flowing ribbon of river.
bridge: A bridge appears as a linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body with visible support pillars and shadow patterns on the water surface, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated roadway of viaduct, the sinuous dark water of river, and the complex dock structures of port.
commercial: Commercial areas display dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings with flat rooftops, extensive paved parking lots between structures, and regular street grids, distinguishing them from the tightly packed houses of residential areas, the large factory buildings of industrial zones, and the uniform gray grid of parking lots.
desert: A desert presents a vast, uniform expanse of light tan or pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures and no vegetation, distinguishing it from the smooth light tan sand with water transition of beach, the uniform bright green grass of meadow, and the rugged rocky terrain of mountain.
farmland: Farmland displays large, regularly gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns, alternating color bands of green and brown, and clear geometric field boundaries, distinguishing it from the uniform bright green grass of meadow, the dense continuous dark green canopy of forest, and the scattered houses of residential areas.
footballfield: A football field features a large, precisely rectangular bright green turf surface with clear white boundary lines, a central circle, and penalty areas, distinguishing it from the uniform unmarked green grass of meadow, the expansive smooth gray runways of airport, and the parallel linear tracks of railway station.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure, distinguishing it from the rugged rocky terrain with elevation changes of mountain, the open green lawns with scattered trees of park, and the uniform bright green grass of meadow.
industrial: Industrial areas display large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops, clusters of circular storage tanks, wide internal roads, and minimal vegetation, distinguishing them from the tightly packed houses of residential areas, the dense commercial building clusters, and the parallel linear railway tracks of railway station.
meadow: A meadow presents a broad, uniform expanse of bright green grass with a smooth fine texture and no visible geometric patterns or markings, distinguishing it from the precisely rectangular marked turf of football field, the regular crop row patterns of farmland, and the open green lawns with scattered trees of park.
mountain: Mountain terrain displays rugged, irregular topography with varied tones of rock and sparse vegetation, showing natural contour patterns and shadow variations from elevation changes, distinguishing it from the continuous dark green canopy of forest, the vast uniform dry sand of desert, and the long elevated concrete structure of viaduct.
parking: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the dense commercial building clusters, the large factory buildings of industrial zones, and the expansive smooth runways of airport.
park: A park features large open green lawns with scattered trees, winding paths, and possibly small recreational facilities, distinguishing it from the dense continuous dark green canopy of forest, the enclosed still water of pond, and the tightly packed houses of residential areas.
pond: A pond appears as a small, enclosed, roughly circular or irregular dark smooth water body surrounded by land with a clear defined shoreline, distinguishing it from the open green lawns of park, the sinuous flowing ribbon of river, and the smooth light tan sand of beach.
port: A port contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, cranes, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the linear water-crossing structure of bridge, the sinuous dark water of river, and the large factory buildings of industrial zones.
railwaystation: A railway station features multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms, adjacent station buildings, and surrounding structures, distinguishing it from the large factory buildings of industrial zones, the expansive smooth runways of airport, and the long continuous elevated roadway of viaduct.
residential: Residential areas display a regular grid of streets with densely or moderately packed rectangular rooftops of houses and visible yards, distinguishing them from the dense medium-to-large flat-roofed buildings of commercial areas, the large factory buildings of industrial zones, and the flat gray paved surfaces of parking lots.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the enclosed still water of pond, the linear elevated structure of bridge, and the complex dock structures of port.
viaduct: A viaduct appears as a long, elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars crossing over terrain or roads and casting rhythmic shadow patterns, distinguishing it from the linear water-crossing structure of bridge, the parallel linear railway tracks of railway station, and the rugged rocky topography of mountain.
